name: Everwood Day Camp
description_short: A day camp in Sharon, MA (near Boston) that runs four 2-week sessions from June 21 to August 13, 2027, plus an optional add-on Post Week. Activities include arts, sports, adventure and waterfront, and tuition includes daily swim lessons.
refund_policy_summary: Before Feb 1, 2027: all tuition and deposits are fully refundable. After Feb 1, 2027: a $150 per week cancellation fee applies to each cancelled week. March 30, 2027 is the last day to reduce weeks for a refund (minus the fee). After the April 1, 2027 balance due date there are no refunds; money paid is credited to the 2028 season, minus $150 per week. No make-up days or credits for missed days.
swim_waterfront_notes: Tuition includes daily swim lessons. The site also has a waterfront program.

warnings: The two price lists on the page don't match. The summary gives Early Bird 2027 rates of $1,890 to $7,350, good through September 30, 2026. The pricing table shows $1,995 to $7,640. Early Bird has ended as of today (2026-10-13), so the table prices were recorded. Confirm with the camp.
The summary says sessions combine into 4, 6, 8 or 9-week summers. The session note says 4, 6 or 8 weeks, and Post Week is 'Add On Only'.
The installment dates are listed in an odd order ('Nov. 1st, April 1st, and Feb. 1st'). Confirm the payment schedule.
The address comes from the check-mailing instructions and the page footer. It is probably the camp location, but the page doesn't say so outright.
